set.body:
Type: acceptance gate
Work key: H02
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Storage/backend lead
Scope: Finite disk, incomplete publication and integrity damage must not destroy or falsely acknowledge accepted data.

Work kind: acceptance-gate
Suggested delivery tranche: T5; actual blocker graph controls readiness.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Capacity accounting/reservations include concurrent staging/export/backup pressure and shared blobs; saturation and client cancellation release capacity without deleting live content.
2. Faults at write, flush, install, catalog publication and response boundaries preserve coherent accepted state; disk-full, permission errors, corruption and interrupted repairs have exact byte and catalog assertions.
3. A bounded resumable scrub and quarantined repair identify every affected retained reference, use verified replacement bytes and produce auditable results; actual tested filesystem/power-loss limits are stated.

Expected review receipt: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/H02/receipt.json

Source/contracts:
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md
- docs/institutional-readiness-backlog.json

Blocked by:
- O02.3: bd-01M4W5P8F383C1WSQ1KBH0Q6WW
- O02.4: bd-01M4W5P8JRY7KB6KQJREBCXEAN
- H02.1: bd-01M4X8MA2FP4M6X4A50CBSTPZ4
- O02.6: bd-01M4W5P8X6VT4X956W3F6VXCZ0

Review existing implementation receipts against this cross-cutting area. Do not duplicate or reparent their tasks. Close only with observed evidence; planning and previous unrelated tests are insufficient.

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
set.title: H02: Review core: Storage safety under failure
